questions.category: Power Fx — Delegation, commands, and performance
questions.prompt: What does delegation mean in a canvas app?
questions.answer: The Power Fx query is translated and executed by the remote data source, which returns only the needed results.
questions.explanation: This is required for correct results over large data sources.
acceptedAnswers: The Power Fx query is translated and executed by the remote data source, which returns only the needed results.

questions.category: Power Fx — Delegation, commands, and performance
questions.prompt: If any part of a query expression is nondelegable, what happens to that query?
questions.answer: Power Apps does not delegate any part of the query and evaluates it locally against the retrieved row limit.
questions.explanation: This is the important all-or-nothing behavior.
acceptedAnswers: Power Apps does not delegate any part of the query and evaluates it locally against the retrieved row limit.

questions.category: Power Fx — Delegation, commands, and performance
questions.prompt: What is the default local row limit for a nondelegable query?
questions.explanation: The setting can be raised, but this does not make a nondelegable query correct for arbitrary large data.

questions.category: Power Fx — Delegation, commands, and performance
questions.prompt: What is the documented maximum canvas-app data row limit for nondelegable queries?

questions.category: Power Fx — Delegation, commands, and performance
questions.prompt: What temporary Data row limit makes hidden nondelegation easiest to detect in testing?
questions.explanation: If the formula still appears to work with a limit of 1, it is strong evidence the relevant query delegates.

questions.category: Power Fx — Delegation, commands, and performance
questions.prompt: Why can a `With` around a large remote query be dangerous even when no delegation warning appears?
questions.answer: `With` creates an in-memory collection internally; collections do not delegate, and this case can produce no delegation warning.
questions.explanation: Absence of a warning is not proof of delegation.
acceptedAnswers: `With` creates an in-memory collection internally; collections do not delegate, and this case can produce no delegation warning.

questions.category: Power Fx — Delegation, commands, and performance
questions.prompt: Does putting remote query results into `Set(...)` make the query delegable?
questions.answer: No. `Set` creates in-memory state and cannot itself participate in delegation.
questions.explanation: The uploaded bank specifically highlights the no-warning trap for `With`, `Set`, and `UpdateContext`.
acceptedAnswers: No. `Set` creates in-memory state and cannot itself participate in delegation.

questions.category: Power Fx — Delegation, commands, and performance
questions.prompt: Does `UpdateContext(...)` participate in delegation?
questions.explanation: It creates screen-scoped in-memory state.

questions.category: Power Fx — Delegation, commands, and performance
questions.prompt: Is `Filter` always delegable?
questions.answer: No. It delegates only when the data source and every function/operator used in the predicate support delegation.
acceptedAnswers: No. It delegates only when the data source and every function/operator used in the predicate support delegation.

questions.category: Power Fx — Delegation, commands, and performance
questions.prompt: When can `Sort` delegate?
questions.answer: When the data source supports delegation for the sort expression used.
questions.explanation: A delegable function can become nondelegable because of the specific formula/data source.
acceptedAnswers: When the data source supports delegation for the sort expression used.

questions.category: Power Fx — Delegation, commands, and performance
questions.prompt: Should you assume `Search` delegates against Dataverse in every host/context?
questions.answer: No. Check the current delegation table and host support; do not infer delegation from the function name.
acceptedAnswers: No. Check the current delegation table and host support; do not infer delegation from the function name.

questions.category: Power Fx — Delegation, commands, and performance
questions.prompt: Should `FirstN` be used to 'fix' a large nondelegable query?
questions.answer: No. Limiting local results is not the same as delegating the query to the server.
acceptedAnswers: No. Limiting local results is not the same as delegating the query to the server.
